set.body:
Phase G (scale). Companion to P8.G2; the read side of the same problem.

Also carries the transport-buffer work if it has not already landed with P7.2:
- protocol/FrameCodec.scala:40 does `var remaining = buffered ++ input` per fed chunk — quadratic in total stream size — plus drop/take per frame at :50,:56-57.
- local/Fs2CommandExecutor.scala:251-255 and ssh/SshProcessRunner.scala:266-270 are byte-for-byte identical CaptureState implementations accumulating Vector[Byte] per fs2 chunk. Both bound retention by ByteLimit so memory is capped; the cost is boxing (~5x) and repeated ++.

scodec-bits is ALREADY a declared dependency of kernel, core and protocol (build.sbt:48,62,79) and ADR 0012 already exists — the migration is documented and provisioned but unapplied on these paths. Coordinate with P7.2 (bd-01KYNA5EAA733KTPSK7M1V1JWZ) rather than duplicating it.
set.title: P8.G3: Batched result reads and transport buffers
